+++ new
#!/bin/bash

set -euo pipefail

# Deterministic build script for reproducible archives

# Configuration
SOURCE_DIR="/app/src"
OUTPUT_ARCHIVE="/app/release.tar.zst"
TEMP_DIR="/tmp/build_$$"
DEFAULT_EPOCH=946684800  # 2000-01-01 00:00:00 UTC

# Setup
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH:-$DEFAULT_EPOCH}
export SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH

# Clean up temp directory on exit
cleanup() {
    rm -rf "$TEMP_DIR"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

echo "Creating deterministic archive..."
echo "Source: $SOURCE_DIR"
echo "Output: $OUTPUT_ARCHIVE"
echo "SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH: $SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"

# Create temporary working directory
mkdir -p "$TEMP_DIR"
WORK_DIR="$TEMP_DIR/work"
mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"

# Copy source tree excluding patterns
echo "Copying and filtering source tree..."
rsync -a \
    --exclude='.git/' \
    --exclude='node_modules/' \
    --exclude='tmp/' \
    --exclude='.cache/' \
    --exclude='__pycache__/' \
    --exclude='*.tmp' \
    --exclude='*.pyc' \
    --exclude='*.o' \
    "$SOURCE_DIR/" "$WORK_DIR/"

# Remove files with exactly 0600 permissions
echo "Removing files with 0600 permissions..."
find "$WORK_DIR" -type f -perm 0600 -delete

# Process files for deterministic build
echo "Processing files..."

# Function to check if file is executable (has shebang or execute permission)
is_executable() {
    local file="$1"
    # Check if it has execute permission OR starts with shebang
    if [[ -x "$file" ]] || [[ -f "$file" && "$(head -c 2 "$file" 2>/dev/null || true)" == "#!" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}

# Function to check if file should have line ending normalization
should_normalize_lineendings() {
    local file="$1"
    local basename="${file##*/}"
    local ext="${basename##*.}"
    
    # Check by file extension
    case "$ext" in
        txt|md|py|sh|c|h|js|css|html|xml|json|yaml|yml)
            return 0
            ;;
    esac
    
    # Check by mime type if file command is available
    if command -v file >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        local mimetype
        mimetype=$(file --brief --mime-type "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
        if [[ "$mimetype" == text/* ]]; then
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    
    return 1
}

# Process all files
find "$WORK_DIR" -type f -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    # Normalize line endings for text files
    if should_normalize_lineendings "$file"; then
        # Convert to LF line endings
        if command -v dos2unix >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            dos2unix -q "$file" 2>/dev/null || true
        else
            # Fallback using sed
            sed -i 's/\r$//' "$file" 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi
    
    # Set permissions
    if is_executable "$file"; then
        chmod 0755 "$file"
    else
        chmod 0644 "$file"
    fi
    
    # Set mtime
    touch -d "@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" "$file"
done

# Process directories
find "$WORK_DIR" -type d -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' dir; do
    chmod 0755 "$dir"
    touch -d "@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" "$dir"
done

# Process symlinks
find "$WORK_DIR" -type l -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' link; do
    touch -h -d "@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" "$link" 2>/dev/null || true
done

# Create deterministic archive
echo "Creating archive..."
cd "$WORK_DIR"

# Create tar with deterministic options
tar --format=gnu \
    --mtime="@$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" \
    --owner=0 \
    --group=0 \
    --numeric-owner \
    --sort=name \
    --create \
    --file="$TEMP_DIR/archive.tar" \
    .

# Compress with zstd
echo "Compressing archive..."
zstd -19 --long --no-check --single-thread \
    --quiet \
    "$TEMP_DIR/archive.tar" \
    -o "$OUTPUT_ARCHIVE"

echo "Archive created: $OUTPUT_ARCHIVE"

# Display archive info
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "SHA256: $(sha256sum "$OUTPUT_ARCHIVE" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
fi

echo "Done."
